source_of_truth: Supabase Postgres after reviewed migration is applied

tables.purpose: Durable mission/workflow/run/correlation state and execution summary
tables.pii_policy: No email, phone, address, credentials, payment data or raw customer content
tables.retention: Operational metadata only; retention policy to be set before production

tables.purpose: Append-only state/evidence lineage for each run
tables.retention: Operational trace; retention policy to be set before production

tables.purpose: Owner/Admin approval decisions for material workflow gates
tables.pii_policy: Actor user UUID + reason text only; no secrets

access.n8n: Future server adapter through controlled gateway, never direct browser credentials

invariants: run_id, workflow_id, mission_id and correlation_id are always present
run state is constrained to canonical state machine values
material actions remain suppressed while control plane mode is SHADOW
approval rows are immutable decision evidence after insert
run events are append-only from client perspective
no raw secrets or customer PII in payload/evidence fields
every approval references one durable run
